subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus focused positive/negative unit tests as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI/Grok rotation error, or require an organic after-fix capture before merge?
rationale: The external-PR proof gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the contributor provided a concrete feasibility argument that the target code-less xAI error only appears after provider-side snapshot/key rotation and cannot be forced by the client without exercising a different error path.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: Record a maintainer proof override for this PR and proceed with normal merge checks because the source-level path, production logs, and regression tests cover the narrow predicate change.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future real xAI/Grok rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway logs showing the retry succeeds.

recommendation.title: Accept a proof override
recommendation.body: Record a maintainer proof override for this PR and proceed with normal merge checks because the source-level path, production logs, and regression tests cover the narrow predicate change.

likelyOwner.reason: This proof-sufficiency choice sits on the OpenAI Responses retry/reasoning recovery path where steipete has the strongest merged history and recent merge ownership signal.
